_comment: Example stdio MCP server configuration for local file system access
_note_on_variables: MCP configs get ${CRABCODE_PLUGIN_ROOT} and ${CRABCODE_PLUGIN_DATA}; every other ${VAR} is read from the user's environment. ${CRABCODE_PROJECT_DIR} is NOT available here - it is injected into hook subprocesses, not into MCP configuration - so a path that must point at the project has to come from a variable the user sets.
